scope: SporeApp.exe 3.1.0.22 gameplay-to-renderer crossings. Inspected triage-v4/v5, Track K, semantic-atlas, reconstruction-packages, cell-movement, BOUNDARIES, all types/*.json partitions, RenderWare research, committed decompilation exports, and current OpenSpore counterparts. This report contains 11 static crossing records: 10 required_for_semantics and 1 replaceable_infrastructure. The strongest crossings are Cell movement/picking, CellGFX lifecycle/preload/effects, Cell pool GFX-handle lifetime, and editor mode/selection/animation. RenderWare::Mesh, RenderWare::CompiledState, and D3D9 device bodies are excluded because no gameplay-facing caller contract was established for them. docs/REPLACEMENT-BOUNDARIES.md is absent from this checkout; docs/BOUNDARIES.md is the available replacement-boundary document.

boundaries.notes: Graphics::IRenderer::Get is a six-byte global accessor, not RenderWare. The gameplay semantic is the camera-ray-to-movement-plane mutation; current OpenSpore implements a clean-room approximation of this path.
